title: docs(releases): 18.4.0 release notes, its v18 index entry and its upgrading row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMm8JPaaTtJz9fQfxByE3KZ)_

Fixes #33106

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新增 18.4.0 发布说明页 `content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx`（沿用 18-3 的骨架），在 `meta.json` 中排在 18-3 之前，v18 索引页加一条 18.4.0 条目，升级页「Per-release specifics」表加 v18.4.0 行；`handwritten-docs.json` 由生成器补一行。
- **为什么改**：18.4.0 已在 npm `latest`，但没有发布页和升级行，升级用户看不到四条新的 `os migrate` 命令、附件 `enable.files` 变化和命名空间收窄（第三次同类缺口，#26631、#29933）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改文档，不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。页面数字全部由 `181ad7d4` 的 CHANGELOG 与 `npm view` 实测，分类用发布脚本自己的 `classifyReleaseBullet`。
- **先看**：① `18-4.mdx` 的「Upgrade checklist」（第 1097 行起）；② 同页「Release facts, as measured」表；③ 开头的编制说明 Callout。
- **两分钟验证**：`git show 181ad7d4 --diff-filter=D --name-only --format= | grep -c '^.changeset/'` 应输出 `1253`，与页面「Changesets consumed」一致。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（本卡的发布页通道已由席位取得逐卡批准记录）。

## What changes

- **`content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx` (new, 1,247 lines).** The 18.4.0 page in 18-3.mdx's skeleton: Highlights; Release facts, as measured (with the 18.4.0 sweep and the post-release smoke); What's new by kind (需手动处理 / 自动迁移 / 新增能力 / 语义变化 / 其他修复, by area); Console (Studio); Upgrade checklist.
- **`content/docs/releases/v18/meta.json`**: `18-4` ahead of `18-3`.
- **`content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx`**: one 18.4.0 bullet under "Per-release notes", in 18.3's shape (claim amendment by the seat).
- **`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`**: the v18.4.0 row of "Per-release specifics", and nothing else.
- **`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`**: +1 line, written by `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write` (the generator; `check:docs-audit-scope` reds without it).

No CHANGELOG is edited, and no tag, publish, `version` script or release-workflow act was taken.

## How the page was compiled

- The 111 `## 18.4.0` sections at `181ad7d4` were split with `splitChangelogEntry` and each bullet placed with `classifyReleaseBullet` from `scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` (the GitHub Release body's own grouping), after dropping `Updated dependencies` bullets and one dependency-list fragment. Deduplicated on full text: 1,252 entries; with the one showcase-only changeset that is the 1,253 the version commit deleted.
- Sections: 244 / 38 / 366 / 9 / 595. Levels from the CHANGELOG level headings: 169 `minor`, 1,083 `patch`. Breaking: 282 (89 `minor`, 193 `patch`). The first four sections are listed in full; 其他修复 is counted by area.
- Each line is the changeset's first line with its conventional prefix removed, its commit and the pull request that commit merged (read from the commit subject, all 1,252 resolved). Seven entries whose first line is their declaration take the commit subject instead; four "Shipped in 18.3.0" entries keep that prefix. Three lines are reworded to the platform's words for the reserved word (ADR-0090 D3), as the callout says.
- Areas are placed mechanically from each summary's words and the packages it touches; the page says so.

## Verification

Local gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against this diff: **61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (`--ran` reconciliation exit 0).

<details><summary>Gate record</summary>

- First pass at `d55197a9`: 54 non-spec gates; 49 exit 0. `check:role-word` exit 1 (3 occurrences of the reserved word on the new page, fixed in `d7190f40`); three `@objectstack/lint` readers exit 3 (prerequisite: lint not built); `check-issue-citations.mjs` exit 124 (my 280 s timeout, network-bound).
- After building the lint closure and the client SDK closure: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, and the seven `@objectstack/spec` readers (`check:docs`, `check:empty-state`, `check:liveness`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:yaml-examples`) all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` exit 0: "citations judged: 850 across 2 file(s) · 718 resolves-as-pull-request · 132 resolves".
- At `d7190f40` (after the wording fix), the page-reading gates re-run, all exit 0: `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs` (and `--strict`), `check-docs-section-name.mjs`, `check-doc-route-spelling.mjs --advisory`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check-affected-docs.mjs`, `check:role-word`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check-section-landing-index.mjs`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check-adr-links.mjs`.
- After merging `origin/main` (2 commits, no file in common): `check:docs-audit-scope` exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Page render check</summary>

The four touched or neighbouring pages compile with `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1 + `remark-gfm` 4.0.1 (the docs site's MDX compiler), exit 0: `18-4.mdx` (324,138 bytes of JS), `v18/index.mdx`, `upgrading.mdx`, and `18-3.mdx` as the positive control. Negative control: a one-line file with an unclosed brace fails the same script (exit 1). The full `next build` of the docs site was not run.

</details>

<details><summary>Facts measured, and where</summary>

- `git show 181ad7d4 --diff-filter=D --name-only` → 1,253 changesets deleted; `git ls-tree 181ad7d4 .changeset/` → none left. Parent of `181ad7d4` = `c4196099`; 1,517 first-parent commits after `83d7e4ae33`.
- Published set: 110 non-private packages at `181ad7d4` (75 `@objectstack/*`, `create-objectstack`, 34 `@object-ui/*`); against `83d7e4ae33`: `@object-ui/providers` gone, `@objectstack/scenarios` and `@objectstack/service-push` new.
- `npm view PACKAGE dist-tags.latest` for all 110 → `18.4.0`; `@objectstack/spec` time `18.4.0` = 2026-11-13T12:30:15.590Z; `next` = `18.2.0`; `@object-ui/providers` latest `18.3.0`; `@object-ui/app-shell` latest `18.2.0`.
- `git ls-remote --tags origin`: 110 `@18.4.0` tags peel to `181ad7d4`.
- The four new commands exist at `181ad7d4` and not at `83d7e4ae33` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/`); `stored-references` takes `--dev` / `--preset` (`COMPOSITION_FLAGS`); `FILES_DISABLED` and `ATTACHMENT_PARENT_ACCESS` in `service-storage`; `NAMESPACE_REFUSED_LITERALS` = the six plus `runs`; the blank starter's `note.object.ts` declares no `enable.files`.
- Sweep: #32908 §0 (round 1) and its record 6852613241 (round 2); the publish-attempt facts from triage records 6851899015 and 6853211089; smoke #33105 cells D1, F3, F4 and observations O1–O4.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The classifier misses seven first-line declarations.** Seven changesets open with their `Clause-②:` line instead of a summary, so `classifyReleaseBullet` reads no declaration and the Release body files all seven under 其他修复, one of them a narrowing (`80c4c9a`, #31864). The page names this and puts the narrowing in the upgrade checklist. Noted, not filed: it is the release script's reading of off-shape changesets, and the GitHub Releases for 18.4.0 are already cut.
- **The upgrade checklist was walked once, by the smoke**, on a one-object blank app; the page says what that walk did and did not run.
- **The areas are a mechanical reading.** An entry that spans two areas sits in the first whose words it matches; the callout says so.
- No changeset: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (docs content plus a script data file), so `skip-changeset` is declared.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no code; CI runs lint)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. (`content/docs/releases/` is this card's subject: a docs-only completeness PR on the release-owned page, approved per card through the seat)
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
